contract.summary: Write down a verbal or telephone order
contract.description:
The nurse who took the order (MSDS 55) writes it down at once in the name of `prescriber_id`, after reading it back
(`read_back: true`): an inpatient (`admission_id`) or an emergency patient (the ER visit's `ticket_id`), never an
outpatient, never chemotherapy (`VERBAL_ORDER_INVALID`); the doctor must be allowed to prescribe it
(`PRESCRIBER_NOT_AUTHORIZED`). It goes to the pharmacy and the chart like a written order; the prescriber is told
(`medication.order.updated`) and countersigns within `verbal_order_countersign_hours`.
The hospital pharmacy must be Active (`CAPABILITY_INACTIVE`).
An id in the request body that does not exist: `REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND` (details.field).

`PRESCRIPTION_INCOMPLETE` (`details.lines`): an ER verbal order's line needs the dose, the
route, how often and for how many days, as an outpatient's.

**Required permission:** `prescription.verbal.record`

**Needs the service:** `dispensing` Active for the hospital pharmacy (destination HospitalPharmacy) (`CAPABILITY_INACTIVE` otherwise; GET /establishment)

contract.summary: Chart a scheduled dose (Administered / Held / Refused / Missed)
contract.description:
Before a dose is given (MSDS 57, 62-68; AAC 30), `Administered` needs: the patient identified (`wristband_code`
as scanned, or `identity_check` TwoIdentifiers; EmergencyOverride with `identity_note` for an emergency or Code Red
admission): `PATIENT_IDENTITY_REQUIRED`, and `PATIENT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH` for another patient's band; the medicine
(`drug_barcode` as scanned, else checked by eye): `DRUG_MISMATCH`; a high-alert medicine checked by a second nurse
or doctor who co-signs (`second_checker_username` / `_password`): `HIGH_ALERT_CHECK_REQUIRED`; a `variance_reason`
for another dose or route, or more than `mar_on_time_window_minutes` from the scheduled time. The caller must be a
registered nurse or doctor (or hold the MedicationAdministration privilege): `ADMINISTRATION_NOT_AUTHORIZED`.
`ADMINISTRATION_VARIANCE_REASON_REQUIRED`: give the reason: the dose differs from the order (route or dose) or is
given outside its time window; `BATCH_EXPIRED`: this batch has expired and cannot be issued; `BATCH_RECALLED`: this
batch is recalled: it cannot be dispensed, sent to a ward, used in theatre or given; `INSUFFICIENT_STOCK`: not
enough stock available; `MAR_STATE_INVALID`: this MAR entry cannot change; add a correction entry;
`SELF_ADMINISTRATION_INVALID`: self-administration is only for an inpatient's oral, inhaled or topical medicine that
is not high-alert, when the doctor allowed it.
A co-signer whose account is locked after wrong passwords: `ACCOUNT_LOCKED`; a wrong co-signer password:
`STEP_UP_REQUIRED`.

`DUAL_CONTROL_SAME_PERSON`: the co-signer is yourself: a second person co-signs.

**Required permission:** `ipd.mar.administer`

**Required permission:** `ipd.mar.administer`

contract.summary: Chart a PRN / ad-hoc dose
contract.description:
The same checks as a scheduled dose (`POST /mar/{mar_id}/chart`), without the time window (backend issue #48): the
patient identified (`wristband_code` as scanned, or `identity_check` TwoIdentifiers; EmergencyOverride with
`identity_note` for an emergency or Code Red admission): `PATIENT_IDENTITY_REQUIRED`, and
`PATIENT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH` for another patient's band; the medicine (`drug_barcode`): `DRUG_MISMATCH`; a
high-alert medicine co-signed by a second nurse or doctor: `HIGH_ALERT_CHECK_REQUIRED`; another dose or route needs
`variance_reason`: `ADMINISTRATION_VARIANCE_REASON_REQUIRED`; `self_administered` only on a line the doctor
allowed: `SELF_ADMINISTRATION_INVALID`; a registered nurse or doctor gives it: `ADMINISTRATION_NOT_AUTHORIZED`.
The line (`prescription_item_id`) comes from `GET /admissions/{admission_id}/mar/prn-orders`: a stopped or cancelled
order: `MEDICATION_ORDER_STOPPED` (409); a line of another admission or of an outpatient order:
`MEDICATION_ORDER_INVALID`; an id that does not exist: `REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND` (details.field).

Always send an `Idempotency-Key` (one per dose given, the same on a retry): a PRN dose has no schedule to guard it,
so a retry after a lost answer would otherwise chart the dose twice.
A co-signer whose account is locked after wrong passwords: `ACCOUNT_LOCKED`; a wrong co-signer password:
`STEP_UP_REQUIRED`.

`DUAL_CONTROL_SAME_PERSON`: the co-signer is yourself: a second person co-signs.

**Required permission:** `ipd.mar.administer`

contract.summary: Find a staff member for a form (badge facts only)
contract.description:
The picker for every form that names a staff member: the affected staff of an incident report, the assistant of
a procedure, the person who cleaned a bed, the employee a work order is assigned to, a member of staff registering
as a patient (`linked_employee_id`), a theatre team member or a visiting consultant. Active employees only, at most
20, best matches first (a name that starts with `q`). Only what their badge shows: id, number, name, designation and
department, and their council registration as every author stamp prints it (`license_type`, `registration`, e.g.
"PMDC 12345-P"); the staff directory with contact details stays with HR (`GET /hr/employees`).

A form that must name a registered doctor sends `license_type=PMDC`: only the clinical staff registered with the
PMDC, their number on file, e.g. the doctor present when contrast is given (`contrast_doctor_id` of
`POST /imaging/orders/{order_id}/status`) or the second doctor of an emergency consent (`second_doctor_id`).
`PNC` lists the registered nurses. Every id here is an `employee_id`, never a `user_id`. `VALIDATION_ERROR`: `q`
shorter than 2 characters, or a `license_type` other than PMDC or PNC.

contract.summary: Hand an inpatient over to another doctor

Takes effect at once (decisions 58): the patient leaves the previous doctor's rounds for the new doctor's, who is
notified; the change is kept with the reason, who made it and when (`changes`). Who may make it:
the treating doctor, handing the patient over (`Handover`); any doctor registered with the PMDC, for an admission
without a doctor (`TakeOver`: a Code Red a triage nurse pressed); the Hospital Admin or a Director

contract.summary: Write a clinical note (draft or finalize=true)

service_gates.when: for a Procedure note with its procedure, not an admission's

contract.description:
Blocked with `CLINICAL_LOCKOUT` ("Patient ticket has been refunded. Cannot add clinical data
without an active billing slip.") or `TICKET_NOT_ACTIVE` for refunded/void/expired tickets.

A bedside procedure (MSDS IMS 150) is a note of type `Procedure` (on the visit or the admission) with `procedure`:
who did what, where, under which anaesthesia and consent, the findings, the specimens, the complications and the
patient's condition at the end. It is signed (finalize) only with the findings, the specimens ('None' if nothing was
removed) and the condition at the end: `PROCEDURE_NOTE_INCOMPLETE` with details.missing otherwise.

`examination_consent` records the patient's permission before the physical examination (VerbalObtained prints as
"VCO"); ask it, never pre-fill it. Under the Clinic profile an OPD or follow-up note is finalized only with it
(`EXAMINATION_CONSENT_REQUIRED`) and with the complaint or history, the findings when examined, a diagnosis and the
plan (`CONSULTATION_INCOMPLETE`, also with `finalize: true`); Declined and NotExamined leave the examination empty
(`VALIDATION_ERROR`).

Always send an `Idempotency-Key` (one per note, the same on a retry): a retry after a lost answer then returns the
first note instead of writing a second one into the patient's record.
An id in the request body that does not exist: `REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND` (details.field).
`ICD_CODE_UNKNOWN`: a code is not in the active ICD code list: pick it from the ICD picker.

`TICKET_PATIENT_MISMATCH`: the ticket is another patient's than `patient_id`: check who the patient is.

**Required permission:** `clinical.encounter.create`

contract.summary: Commit the note (immutable afterwards)
contract.description:
Sign the draft: it is immutable afterwards (corrections are appended) and an OPD visit becomes Examined. Only the
authoring doctor (`FORBIDDEN`); a final note answers `FINALIZED_RECORD_IMMUTABLE`. A note needs a complaint, a
diagnosis or a clinical note (`VALIDATION_ERROR`); a Procedure note its findings, specimens and condition at the end
(`PROCEDURE_NOTE_INCOMPLETE`). Under the Clinic profile an OPD or follow-up note also needs the examination consent
(`EXAMINATION_CONSENT_REQUIRED`) and what the clinic manual's record contains (indicator 28): the complaint or
history, the examination findings when VCO was obtained, a diagnosis and the plan (`CONSULTATION_INCOMPLETE`,
details.missing). A refunded or void ticket: `CLINICAL_LOCKOUT` / `TICKET_NOT_ACTIVE`; `NOT_FOUND`.

**Required permission:** `clinical.encounter.create`

**Required permission:** `clinical.encounter.create`

contract.summary: Doctor: Admit Patient (→ Admission_Pending)
contract.description:
The reason for admission and the provisional diagnosis are required (MSDS 149; the database refuses an admission
without them, `ADMISSION_DETAILS_REQUIRED`), the initial care plan optional. They are recorded once, under the
requesting doctor's stamp (`details_stamp`); later thinking goes into the inpatient notes.
`requested_ward_id` is optional (the doctor's preference; without it the admissions desk picks the ward): offer the
wards of `GET /beds/matrix?include_beds=false`, the open ones. A ward closed in the IT console takes no patient
(decisions 55): `VALIDATION_ERROR` (details.field `requested_ward_id`) and nothing is created; re-read the matrix,
keep what the doctor typed and choose another ward or none.
`primary_doctor_id` (default: you) names another treating doctor: an active doctor registered with the PMDC
(`GET /staff/lookup?license_type=PMDC`); anyone else answers `VALIDATION_ERROR` (details.field `primary_doctor_id`,
decisions 57) and nothing is created.
An id in the request body that does not exist: `REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND` (details.field).

**Required permission:** `ipd.admission.request`

**Needs the service:** `inpatient` Active (`CAPABILITY_INACTIVE` otherwise; GET /establishment)

view admissions. The sterile supply (`cssd.operate`) and infection control (`infection.control.manage`) read it for

contract.summary: Re-route / Refer to another doctor (top of their queue)
contract.description:
Workflow §1.4 — the Quick-Action Bar button. The patient keeps their place: they go to the
TOP of the new doctor's queue. Reception dashboards update silently via WebSocket.

The doctor whose queue it is re-routes: the patient was sent to the wrong doctor, or asked for one who cannot
handle their case. Choose `target_doctor_id` from `GET /opd-queues/doctors`, or `target_department_id` alone (a
department with an OPD doctor: its doctors see the patient). The ticket and its payment move with the patient: no
new slip, no refund. `opd.queue.updated` tells both doctors and the reception (the new entry with priority high,
`is_rerouted`, `reroute_reason`). A patient in consultation goes back to Waiting in the new queue.

`VALIDATION_ERROR` (details.field `target_doctor_id` or `target_department_id`): not a doctor who sees an OPD queue,
the doctor whose queue it already is, or a department without one. An id in the request body that does not exist:
`REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND` (details.field). `FORBIDDEN`: another doctor's queue entry.
`QUEUE_ENTRY_CLOSED`: the entry was re-routed, deferred or ended meanwhile: refresh the queue.
`TICKET_TRANSITION_INVALID`: only a Waiting or InConsultation ticket is re-routed.

**Required permission:** `opd.queue.reroute`

**Required permission:** `opd.queue.reroute`

contract.summary: Upload a patient document (PDF/JPEG/PNG)
contract.description:
Stored in the protected patient vault; only its path and SHA-256 are in the database. Documents are PDF, JPEG or
PNG (a scan or a photo of the paper); `doc_type=Photo`, the Patient Photo, is a JPEG or PNG only, at most 16
megapixels. The Patient Photo is **optional** at registration, at admission and everywhere else: offer it, never
require it (an emergency, facial injuries, a patient who cannot cooperate or declines it: purdah, privacy). The
newest one is `photo_document_id` on the patient and on the admission.

Reports, tests and prescriptions the patient brings from elsewhere: `is_outside=true` with `source_facility`, the
date on the paper (`document_date`) and a `title` naming the test or report; `doc_type` `LabReport`, `Imaging`,
`DischargeSummary`, `Prescription`, `ReferralLetter` or `Other`. They stay attachments for the doctor to read, never
results of this hospital's laboratory or imaging.

`UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE`: another file type, a PDF as the Photo, or content that is not the type the file claims;
`VALIDATION_ERROR`: a damaged or oversized image, an outside document without its facility, a Photo marked outside,
a date in the future; `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` above MAX_UPLOAD_MB; `NOT_FOUND`: no such patient.

**Required permission:** `patient.document.upload`

**Required permission:** `patient.document.upload`

bed whose ward was closed meanwhile (`details.in_service` false): re-read `GET /beds/matrix` and pick another bed.

contract.summary: No bed: add to the ward waitlist

hears `bed.waitlist.notification` when a bed of that ward frees up, then allocates it with
`POST /admissions/{admission_id}/allocate-bed`. Only an AdmissionPending admission is waitlisted.
An id in the request body that does not exist: `REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND` (details.field). A closed ward (not in
`GET /beds/matrix`) takes no waiting patient: `VALIDATION_ERROR` (details.field `ward_id`); choose another ward.

`ADMISSION_STATE_INVALID` (409, not retryable): the admission is Waitlisted already (a repeat after a lost answer),
has a bed, or was cancelled. Nothing changes: read `GET /admissions/{admission_id}` again, show where it stands and
keep what the user chose; never retry.

contract.summary: Confirm how a Code Red admission is paid (ends its billing deferral)
contract.description:
A Code Red admission starts with `is_billing_deferred`: nothing about money is asked while the patient is being
saved. Deferred is never free: room charges, medicines and procedures go on the running bill from the first day.
Once the patient is stable (and identified: merge the trauma profile into the permanent one first), the admissions
desk confirms Cash or the panel here; a draft running bill takes the panel. Until then the final bill and the
BillingSettlement stage of the discharge answer `BILLING_DEFERRED` (details.next_step names this call).
`BILLING_NOT_DEFERRED` when there is nothing to confirm (billing was confirmed at allocation, or already here),
`ADMISSION_STATE_INVALID` for a cancelled admission, `REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND` for an unknown or inactive panel,
`VALIDATION_ERROR` when panel_id does not match the category, `NOT_FOUND`.

**Required permission:** `ipd.admission.allocate OR ipd.discharge.clear_billing`

contract.summary: Create the installation's first Owner (once; temporary password shown ONCE)
contract.description:
A new installation has only the Super Admin of the setup, who has no HR rights (HR/IT separation, §6.2), so nobody
could onboard the first member of staff. Once per installation, IT creates the first Owner here: an active staff
record (designation, CNIC number, mobile) and a login with the roles chosen (owner always; add `hr_admin` so the
Owner can onboard HR or do it themselves, and the clinical role of an owner who practises). The Owner changes the
temporary password at first login, then completes their personnel file: the CNIC copy, and the PMDC/PNC licence of
an owner who practises, stay listed as missing until uploaded. Everyone else, later owners included, comes through
HR's wizard and IT's provisioning.

`FIRST_OWNER_EXISTS` once an Owner or Hospital Admin has ever existed here (the database refuses it too);
`VALIDATION_ERROR` for super_admin or phc_inspector among the roles, or an unknown role.

**Required permission:** `admin.user.provision`

**Required permission:** `admin.user.provision`

access.who: admin.settings.manage for a setting, admin.user.manage for a user's roles, admin.role_matrix.update for a role's permissions (the service checks)

contract.description:
Submit a change to a control setting (`Setting`), a user's roles (`UserRoles`) or a role's permissions
(`RolePermissions`). An Owner's own request is applied at once (`status == "Applied"`); anyone else's waits for an
Owner in the approvals queue (`PolicyChange` or `PrivilegedAccess`).

`FORBIDDEN`, `VALIDATION_ERROR` (a setting's value of the wrong type or outside its range is refused here, not at the
Owner's approval), `SELF_ROLE_CHANGE_FORBIDDEN`, `LAST_OWNER`; on a DEV server the roles of a shared
demo account (`demo.*`): `DEMO_ACCOUNT_PROTECTED`. A setting, user or role that does not
exist: `REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND` (details.field: `setting_key`, `target_user_id` or `target_role_code`).

`ICD_SYSTEM_NOT_LOADED`: an approver's own change is applied at once, and the ICD coding
system chosen has no code list loaded.

contract.summary: Record a consent as given
contract.description:
After the paper is signed. `signer`: the patient, or when the patient cannot decide a decision maker the policy
allows for this patient (`CONSENT_SIGNER_INVALID`: a minor alone, a relationship the policy does not allow, the same
doctor as second doctor). With the questions asked and the answers, and the understanding confirmed (MSDS 35 ii, 43
iii). A thumb impression and the forms that say so need a witness. `mode: EmergencyNote`: nobody could consent and
the treatment could not wait; a doctor writes why, and a second registered doctor concurs when the hospital says so.
The caller is the professional who explained it and is stamped on it: a registered doctor for an informed consent,
a doctor of the anaesthesia team for anaesthesia (`CONSENT_TAKER_NOT_AUTHORIZED`). What is missing:
`CONSENT_INCOMPLETE` with `details.missing`. Final afterwards: scan the paper (`POST .../scan`).
`CONSENT_STATE_INVALID`: the consent cannot change that way: a decided consent is final (withdraw it and take a new
one).

**Required permission:** `consent.record`

**Required permission:** `consent.record`

contract.summary: Take a bed out of / back into service
contract.description:
`OutOfService` takes an Available, Dirty or Cleaning bed out of use (a broken bed, a bed needed for repair);
`Available` brings it back into service and tells the admissions desk when its ward has a waitlist. The reason
(3-300 characters) is kept in the bed's history.

`BED_STATE_INVALID` (409, not retryable): the bed cannot move to that state from where it is now (the bed state
machine): a Reserved or Occupied bed is never taken out of service or made Available; release the reservation, or

contract.summary: Dispense Now (partial allowed, FEFO)
contract.description:
Dispensing less than prescribed leaves the prescription `PartiallyDispensed`; the patient can
return later for the rest without a new prescription. Batches are chosen First-Expired-First-Out
by the server — the client never picks a batch, and never gets a recalled one.

A high-alert medicine (MSDS 57): a second person (another pharmacist, or the nurse or doctor collecting it) checks
the order and the medicine and co-signs with `checker_username` / `checker_password` (`HIGH_ALERT_CHECK_REQUIRED`
without). A line the pharmacist queried waits for the doctor's answer (`PRESCRIPTION_QUERY_OPEN`). Print the labels
afterwards: `GET /dispensations/{dispensation_id}/labels`.

Cash goes into the caller's own open cash shift at the Pharmacy Counter (node `PharmacyCounter`), never a drawer
open at another counter: `SHIFT_NOT_OPEN` without one, `details.node` `PharmacyCounter` and `details.open_shift` the
caller's shift open at another counter (`shift_id`, `node`) or null. Check before offering Cash:
`GET /finance/cash-shifts/mine?node=PharmacyCounter` (null: open it on My cash shift, at a PC IT mapped to the
Pharmacy Counter, `GET /terminals/whoami` `cash_node`). Card and the other payment modes need no shift.
An id in the request body that does not exist: `REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND` (details.field).
`CHARITY_APPROVAL_REQUIRED`: a Zakat/charity officer must approve this override; `DUAL_CONTROL_SAME_PERSON`: the
second approver must be a different person; `INSUFFICIENT_STOCK`: not enough stock available;
`PRESCRIPTION_NOT_DISPENSABLE`: this prescription cannot be dispensed.
A co-signer whose account is locked after wrong passwords: `ACCOUNT_LOCKED`; a wrong co-signer password:
`STEP_UP_REQUIRED`.

`OPD_PHARMACY_CREDIT_NOT_ALLOWED`: `PanelCredit` for a patient whose panel does not allow credit.

`OVERPAYMENT`: the payment is more than the amount due (`details.balance_due`).

**Required permission:** `pharmacy.dispense`

contract.summary: Progress / cancel an imaging order
contract.description:
`InProgress` records the checks before the examination (MSDS AAC 10, 13): the patient identified (`wristband_code`
scanned, or `identity_check` TwoIdentifiers; `EmergencyOverride` with a note for an emergency patient), the site and

`IMAGING_SAFETY_CHECK_REQUIRED`. `Completed` with `contrast` (agent, dose, route) names the doctor present:
`contrast_doctor_id`, the `employee_id` of a doctor registered with the PMDC, picked with
`GET /staff/lookup?q=...&license_type=PMDC` (any user may call it); no doctor, or one who is not PMDC-registered:
`IMAGING_SAFETY_CHECK_REQUIRED`.
Moves the state machine allows only (`IMAGING_ORDER_STATE_INVALID`); `Cancelled` needs a reason.
`PATIENT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH`: the wristband scanned is not this patient's: stop and check who the patient is.

`INVOICE_HAS_PAYMENTS`: a cancelled order's bill has a payment: refund it first.

contract.summary: Link the PACS study (auto-find by accession if no ids given)
contract.description:
Links the study the modality sent to the hospital's PACS (Orthanc). With `{}` the server finds it by the order's
`accession_number`. A radiographer who copied the study's Orthanc id from the PACS (the modality was given no or a
wrong accession number) sends `orthanc_study_id`: the server asks the PACS for that study and takes its
`study_instance_uid` from there, never from the request. An examination in progress becomes Completed; an order
never started keeps its status until the radiographer records the checks before the examination. The worker also
links studies by accession number every two minutes, so a study that has not arrived yet links itself later.

`PACS_NOT_CONFIGURED`: this server has no PACS (IT has not set `ORTHANC_ENABLED`, the default): nothing is linked,
the order is unchanged, and retrying never helps; complete the examination with `POST /imaging/orders/{order_id}/
status` (`Completed`), and the report works without images. `ORTHANC_UNAVAILABLE` (retryable): the PACS did not
answer; the order is unchanged. `IMAGING_STUDY_NOT_FOUND`: the PACS has no study with this accession number yet
(`details.accession_number`) or no study with this `orthanc_study_id`: nothing is linked. `IMAGING_ORDER_STATE_INVALID`:
the order is cancelled. `NOT_FOUND`: no such order.

**Required permission:** `imaging.order.update`

contract.summary: Verify (publish + notify doctor) or reject back to the bench
contract.description:
After a lost answer, never repeat the decision by itself: read `GET /lab/requisitions/{requisition_id}` (the
queue row's `requisition_id`) and find this `result_id` in its `results`. `Published` (with `verified_stamp`) or
`Rejected`: decided; still `PendingVerification`: not decided, offer it again.
Verified publishes the result: `lab.result.published` goes to the ordering doctor and the verifiers; a lab-only
walk-in has no ordering doctor, so it goes to the reception desk that registers walk-ins (the users holding both
`patient.create` and `lab.requisition.create`), who hand its report over.
The technician who entered a result cannot verify it (`LAB_VERIFIER_MUST_DIFFER`). Verifying a critical result
(`has_critical_value`) opens it in the critical results log (`GET /critical-results`): tell the doctor now and
record it there (MSDS AAC 5). `delay_reason`: why a late result was late (MSDS AAC 4). A result already verified or
rejected: `LAB_RESULT_STATE_INVALID`.

contract.summary: Collect a sample → returns the barcode label print payload
contract.description:
OPD / walk-in samples require the lab bill to be paid first (`LAB_PAYMENT_REQUIRED`) unless the
hospital disabled `lab_require_payment_before_sample`. IPD and Emergency are exempt.

The patient is identified as the sample is taken (MSDS AAC 3): scan the wristband (`wristband_code`;
`PATIENT_IDENTITY_MISMATCH` when it is another patient's), or ask two identifiers (`identity_check`
TwoIdentifiers: the name and the date of birth or MRN), or for an emergency patient who cannot be identified yet
`EmergencyOverride` with a note. Nothing given: `PATIENT_IDENTITY_REQUIRED`. Label the tube at the patient's side.
The sample cannot do that in its present state: `LAB_SAMPLE_STATE_INVALID`.

**Required permission:** `lab.sample.collect`

**Required permission:** `lab.sample.collect`

contract.summary: Re-print a sample barcode label
contract.description:
Call it only to print (a printer jam, a smudged label), never for a preview: every call is one more label
printed, whether or not the printer printed it. It counts in the sample's `label_print_count` (`GET /lab/scan`;
the collection printed the first) and is recorded in the PHI access log, as the label carries the patient's name
and MRN. It never changes the sample: `row_version` stays, so nothing needs reloading before the next action.
`NOT_FOUND`.

contract.summary: Submit & Broadcast a result (goes to the verifier)
contract.description:
One transaction: result row (PendingVerification) + reagent deduction by BOM (FEFO) +
`lab.result.pending_verification` event to verifiers. The ordering doctor sees nothing yet. A text metric's value in
its `critical.values` (e.g. Positive) is flagged C and critical, like a number beyond a critical limit.

A sample sent to a partner laboratory: enter the partner's values with `partner_report_ref` and
`partner_reported_at`; the result is stamped with the partner and the report says the test was outsourced.
`LAB_METRICS_INVALID`: metric values do not match the test's metric schema; `LAB_REAGENT_BOM_MISSING`: this test has
no reagent bill-of-materials configured.

`INSUFFICIENT_STOCK`: not enough reagent for the test.

**Required permission:** `lab.result.enter`

**Required permission:** `lab.result.enter`

contract.summary: The establishment's profile and services, with the configuration revision
contract.description:
The PHC category on the licence (Clinic, II C, II B, II A or I) with its MSDS framework, and every clinical
service in the release with its state: Available (never switched on), Preparing, Active, Retiring (no new work; the
open work listed continues) or Retired (records only). `active` lists the services whose new work may start: hide
the `operations` of the others (OpenAPI x-capability-gates; a gate with `when` hides only the choice it names, one
with `continues_while_retiring` stays while the service is Retiring). Every other operation stays: reads, the steps
of work already started, corrections.

`views` says what each workspace and screen that exists for a service shows now: `full`, `open_work` (Retiring: no
new work, a banner), `records` (history only), `setup` (only from Facility settings) or `hidden`; a workspace or
screen not listed is core and always shown. One frontend build serves every profile: apply `views`, never a rule of
your own about the category (it picks the inspection framework and the letterhead, nothing on the menus).

Read it after login and again on `establishment.changed`. `revision` is what a change must name.

`rules_in_force` lists the few rules that follow the category instead of a service (a clinic's complete
consultation, a Category I or II A high-risk pregnancy's nutrition): show the ones that apply on their screens.

contract.summary: Apply a change of profile or services
contract.description:
Everything in the change, or nothing: the revision must be the one previewed (`VERSION_CONFLICT`: preview
again), every check runs again (`ESTABLISHMENT_CHANGE_REFUSED` with the problems), every acknowledgement of the
preview must be sent back (`CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`). A service moved to Retiring stops new work at once while its
open work continues; Retired needs none left (`CAPABILITY_WORK_OUTSTANDING`). The database refuses a move it does
not allow (`CAPABILITY_TRANSITION_NOT_ALLOWED`), a missing dependency (`CAPABILITY_DEPENDENCY`), an indoor service
under the Clinic profile (`CAPABILITY_NOT_PERMITTED`) and a service not in this release
(`CAPABILITY_NOT_IMPLEMENTED`). A category that differs from the beds' suggestion needs a reason
(`MSDS_CATEGORY_REASON_REQUIRED`). Then every terminal receives `establishment.changed`.

contract.summary: Register + OPD slip + payment + queue token (atomic)

service_gates.when: for an emergency patient (source Emergency) without an open emergency visit

contract.description:
Workflow §1.1/§1.3. Returns the ticket, invoice, queue token and a ready-to-print OPD slip
(`print_payload`). The assigned doctor's screen updates live via `opd.queue.updated`. The doctor (`doctor_id`) is
one who sees an OPD queue (`GET /opd-queues/doctors`, by department with the patients waiting): anyone else answers
`VALIDATION_ERROR` (details.field `doctor_id`). A patient sent to the wrong doctor is re-routed by that doctor
(`POST /opd-queues/{queue_id}/reroute`).

Blocking rules: outstanding dues → `AR_OUTSTANDING_BLOCK` (unless `emergency_bypass` or
`ar_override_reason` + permission); discount above your ceiling → `DISCOUNT_CEILING_EXCEEDED`.

Cash goes through the caller's own open cash shift: `SHIFT_NOT_OPEN` without one (open it on My cash shift).
An id in the request body that does not exist: `REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND` (details.field).
`PATIENT_MERGED_CANNOT_TRANSACT`: this patient record was merged; use the master record.

`LAB_ONLY_QUEUE_FORBIDDEN`: the patient was registered as a lab-only walk-in: complete the full registration
first (`PATCH /patients/{patient_id}` with `upgrade_to_regular`), then register the visit.

`OVERPAYMENT`: the payment is more than the slip's amount due (`details.balance_due`).

**Required permission:** `opd.ticket.create`

**Needs the service:** `emergency_department` Active for an emergency patient (source Emergency) without an open emergency visit (`CAPABILITY_INACTIVE` otherwise; GET /establishment)

contract.summary: Rotate the refresh token and get a new access token
contract.description:
Call shortly before the access token expires. The old refresh token becomes invalid;
presenting it again returns `REFRESH_TOKEN_REUSED` and ends that login everywhere.

`UNAUTHENTICATED` (an unknown refresh token), `TOKEN_REVOKED` (signed out, or the password changed),
`TOKEN_EXPIRED` (past its expiry), `ACCOUNT_DISABLED` (the account was disabled) and `LICENSE_INVALID` (the
server's licence is not valid, as at login): never retry the refresh; show the login screen.

contract.summary: Returning-patient lookup by name / phone / CNIC / UPMRN / MRN
contract.description:
Each hit includes `outstanding` → show the red **OUTSTANDING BALANCE: RS. X** banner when
`has_outstanding_ar` is true (workflow §1.2).

`q` is an MRN or UPMRN (exact, any case: a scanned slip), a mobile number (7 digits or more: the last 10 are
compared), a CNIC (13 digits, dashes or not) or a part of the name. A name may contain digits (the trauma label "Unknown
Male 3"): any term with a letter is also looked for in the names; a term of digits alone is only a number.

Merged profiles are matched too, and each person comes back once, as their master record: the MRN on an old slip,
a trauma label or a merged duplicate's name or numbers find the master, with `matched_merged_profile` naming the
merged profile that matched (null when the master itself did). The best match comes first: an exact MRN, then the
closest name. `VALIDATION_ERROR`: fewer than 2 characters once the spaces are trimmed.

contract.summary: The server's license state: show a banner when it needs attention — works before login
contract.description:
`state`: `ok` | `dev` (nothing to show) · `grace` (a problem was found, e.g. the server's hardware
changed: the hospital keeps working until `grace_until`, `days_left` days) · `locked` (the grace period
ended: `logins` is `super_admin_only`, so everyone else gets `LICENSE_INVALID` at login until IT installs
the new license the vendor issues).

While `state` is `grace` or `locked`, show `message` and the `vendor` contact (company, phone, whatsapp,
email, website) as a banner on the login screen and on every workspace, prominently: the hospital must
contact the vendor within the grace period. `notice` (may be set even when `ok`) is a milder warning,
e.g. a time-limited license ending within 30 days, for administrators. Poll it on the login screen and
every 10 minutes; the realtime event `system.license` announces changes immediately.

DEV builds only: send `X-Haspataal-License-Simulation: grace` or `locked` to see a simulated state on your own
requests (this one, login, refresh); the server and everyone else are unaffected (frontend guide 09).

contract.summary: E-prescription (hospital pharmacy or external slip)
contract.description:
Hospital pharmacy → pharmacist queue (`pharmacy.prescription.pending`); inpatient orders
also generate MAR doses. External → `status = ExternalPrinted`, print it with
`GET /prescriptions/{id}/print-payload`; never queued and never touches stock.
HospitalPharmacy requires Active dispensing (`CAPABILITY_INACTIVE`); otherwise choose ExternalMarket.

The prescriber is the caller: a PMDC-registered doctor, or a clinician with the Prescribing privilege; a restricted
medicine needs the RestrictedPrescribing privilege (`PRESCRIBER_NOT_AUTHORIZED`, MSDS 52). Show each line's
`high_alert_category` and `lasa_with` warnings from the formulary search. `self_administration` (inpatients): an
oral, inhaled or topical medicine that is not high-alert (`SELF_ADMINISTRATION_INVALID`, MSDS 70), whatever the
destination: an ExternalMarket line qualifies when it names a drug of the hospital's list (`drug_id`), never a typed
`external_drug_name`, whose high-alert status is unknown (decisions 59). An outpatient
(OPD, ER) line needs the dose, the route, how often and for how many days, a single STAT dose the dose and the route
(`PRESCRIPTION_INCOMPLETE` with details.lines). A nurse writes down a verbal order with `POST /prescriptions/verbal`.
An id in the request body that does not exist: `REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND` (details.field).

**Required permission:** `prescription.create`

**Needs the service:** `dispensing` Active for the hospital pharmacy (destination HospitalPharmacy) (`CAPABILITY_INACTIVE` otherwise; GET /establishment)

or referral slip: `VALIDATION_ERROR`). The receiving facility from the contact list (`destination_contact_id`,
`REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND` for an unknown or retired one) or by name when the patient chooses it

(`GET /referrals/{id}/pdf`), which stays in the record. `transport` WithStaff needs `escort_name` and leaves the

doctor (`REFERRAL_AUTHOR_INVALID`). Linked sources must identify the same visit (`VALIDATION_ERROR`); refunded or
voided tickets retain their clinical lockout. Patient particulars and the referring doctor's stamp are saved at
issue, so subsequent master-data edits do not rewrite the letter.

contract.summary: Report an incident, an adverse event or a near miss
contract.description:
Anyone reports, the same day, without blame: the type (`GET /incident-types`), incident or near miss, the harm,
when and where, who was affected, what happened and what was done at once. A theatre adverse event gives the
operation and the phase (`INCIDENT_DETAILS_REQUIRED` otherwise, MSDS COP 40); a medication error the stage and the
medicine (CQI 102). The database classes it a sentinel event from the list and the harm; the managers are told at once
(`incident.reported`, critical for a sentinel event). Reporting what the screening list found: send its
`screening_key` (`INCIDENT_SCREENING_DECIDED` when it was reported or dismissed already).
An id in the request body that does not exist: `REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND` (details.field).
`INCIDENT_TYPE_INACTIVE`: this incident type is no longer on the hospital's list.

contract.description:
Requires the request's `required_permission`. You never approve your own request (`SELF_APPROVAL_FORBIDDEN`,
`details` says why: `solo_practice_mode`, `owner`, `other_approvers`), except the Owner of a solo practice who is
the only person able to decide a refund, waiver or credit: with the Owner's `solo_practice_mode` on, that Owner
approves their own request with a `note` (without one: `VALIDATION_ERROR`); the answer says
`solo_self_approved: true` and a risk item records it. The request's `can_decide` and `self_decision` say all this
in advance. `APPROVAL_ALREADY_DECIDED`: decided already. `DUAL_CONTROL_SAME_PERSON`: a large cash drop is never
approved by the cashier of its shift (no co-signer is typed here); `SELF_ROLE_CHANGE_FORBIDDEN`: nobody
changes their own roles; `LAST_OWNER`: an approved role change would leave the hospital without an active Owner.

contract.summary: The end-user handbook's outline for the logged-in employee (only what they may use)

access.who: any logged-in user, for their own account (also before a forced password change where allowed)

contract.description:
The hospital's staff learn the software from the handbook the frontend team ships inside the desktop app as a
localhost-only searchable help site (guide "The end-user handbook"). This answer is its table of contents for THIS
user: the workspaces (their own first), the screens they may open (a screen of their own workspaces appears when the
server lets them call at least one of its endpoints; so does a screen of another workspace that one of theirs also
uses, `also_uses` of `GET /meta/workspaces`, listed in their workspace with `workspace` still naming its own: the
Owner's Receivables; any other screen of another workspace only when they may call every endpoint of it that needs a
permission) and, per screen, the tasks they may do in user words, the rules the page explains and
the realtime updates. The help window shows exactly these pages (`page` = `screens/<id>`, `workspaces/<code>`) and
builds its search over them, so nobody reads how to do what they are not allowed to do. Call it after login and
after a role change; the "?" button of a screen opens `screens/<its id>`.

F1 in a workspace window passes that window's `workspace`: the answer then lists that workspace and the shared screens
only, even for a user with several roles (`active_workspace`); without the parameter the window's `X-Active-Workspace`
header decides; on the launcher, call it with neither. An
unknown workspace: `VALIDATION_ERROR`; one that is not the user's: `FORBIDDEN`. The screens and workspaces of a service
that shows nothing now (`GET /establishment` views: hidden) are left out, and each screen says what it shows (`view`).

`faq_seed` lists the questions the FAQ of each listed workspace must answer, at least: one per error a screen of the
workspace can meet (the errors every screen meets, explained once by the general error help, are left out) and one
per state machine its screens move. Questions only: the help writes the answers in the user's words.

`print=true` with `workspace` adds `print_edition`: the cover (the hospital, its PHC number and category, the
workspace, the version and the date) and the chapters in print order (the workspace page, its screens, the shared
screens, the FAQ), from which the app compiles the printable guide of that workspace from the same pages as F1.
`print=true` without `workspace`: `VALIDATION_ERROR`.

tasks.summary: Outstanding Patient Dues queue (with age of debt)

rules: 'Write off' (with its reason) only for finance.ar.write_off: the Owner and the Hospital Admin, who open this screen from their workspace; a cashier collects and settles but never writes off.

workspaces.label: Admissions Desk
workspaces.description: Pending admissions, live bed matrix, bed allocation, waitlists, overflow.

screens.title: Record a complaint
screens.purpose: Record a complaint as it is made, verbally or in writing, and give the complainant the tracking number.
rules: Form: how it came (in person, telephone, letter, suggestion box, from the Punjab Healthcare Commission), the complainant and how to reach them (a phone or an address unless anonymous or from the box), the patient (search by MRN) or the admission, the department, the category, the complaint in their words, what they ask for. Send an Idempotency-Key.
Give the complainant the complaint_number at once: it is their tracking number. The complaints officer acknowledges it within the day with the name of their contact person.
An appeal against the outcome comes to any desk: open the complaint (GET /complaints?mine=true or by number) and 'Record appeal' while can_appeal (COMPLAINT_APPEAL_LATE after the window).

workspaces.label: Badge station kiosk
workspaces.description: Not a user workspace: the full-screen page of a barcode-scanner badge station (no login; authenticated by the station's key).

screens.title: Badge station kiosk
screens.purpose: Full-screen page on a PC / tablet with a barcode scanner (or camera): staff show their badge, the page posts the scan and flashes the outcome. No login, no keyboard for the person scanning.

tasks.summary: Kiosk screen setup: what this station does (station-authenticated)
A badge was presented at a station (station-authenticated, no user login)

rules: Configure once with the station id and its key (X-Station-Key); never show the key.
A USB scanner types the code and Enter: keep an invisible input focused; or decode the camera stream.
needs_bed_code: collect two scans (bed sticker HMS-BED-… and badge) within 60 s, then post them together.

shared_screens.title: Report an incident
shared_screens.purpose: Anyone reports an incident, an adverse event or a near miss, the same day, without blame.

tasks.summary: What to report: the incident types
Report an incident, an adverse event or a near miss

rules: A button on every workspace's toolbar. Form: the type (GET /incident-types, grouped by area, sentinel types marked), incident or near miss, harm, when (now by default) and where (department, ward, place), who was affected (a patient: search by MRN; staff: the employee), what happened (facts, not blame) and what was done at once; 'Keep my name confidential' (reporter_confidential).
Medication errors: the stage and the medicine; theatre events: the operation and the phase (INCIDENT_DETAILS_REQUIRED). Send an Idempotency-Key: a double click must not report twice.
After sending: show the incident number and 'The Quality Officer will review it'. 'My reports' = GET /incidents?mine=true.

shared_screens.title: Incidents I investigate
shared_screens.purpose: The analysis of an incident the Quality Officer asked you to investigate, and its actions.

tasks.summary: Save the analysis (a draft until signed)

rules: List: GET /incidents?mine=true&status=UnderReview (analysis_overdue in red). Show it only to users who have one (notification category incident when named).

Analysis form (save as you go with PUT): method (RootCauseAnalysis for a sentinel event), what happened in order, root causes, contributing factors (checkboxes of the fixed list), lessons, whether the patient or the family was told and how, any report made outside (DRAP, PHC).
Sign: INCIDENT_ANALYSIS_INCOMPLETE lists details.missing. A sentinel event needs at least one factor of the system, not only 'Individual' or 'Patient' (MSDS CQI 107: blame alone is not an analysis).

shared_screens.title: Complaints I investigate
shared_screens.purpose: The complaints the complaints officer asked you to investigate: the findings, keeping the complainant informed, the actions.

tasks.summary: Write the findings of the investigation

rules: List: GET /complaints?mine=true&status=Acknowledged, by answer_due (answer_overdue in red). Show the screen only to users who have one (notification category complaint).
Findings: what the investigation found (facts, the people spoken to, the records read). The complaints officer conveys the outcome.
Tell the complainant how it stands, or that it needs more time and until when (Extension), before answer_due.

faq_seed.question: The Outstanding dues (Udhaar) screen says "Open a cash shift before handling cash." (SHIFT_NOT_OPEN). Why, and what do I do?
What do the states of a complaint mean (Received, Acknowledged, Resolved, Appealed, Closed, Withdrawn, NotMaintainable), and what moves it from one to the next?
The Record a complaint screen says "The appeal window of this complaint has ended." (COMPLAINT_APPEAL_LATE). Why, and what do I do?

The same description LAN discovery broadcasts (see the *Connecting terminals* guide):
`urls` (best first; the address this terminal reached us on is included), `ca_fingerprint_sha256`
of the hospital root CA, `server_name`, `hospital_name`, `version`, `build`, `discovery_port`.

Call it after connecting and **store all `urls`** as alternates: if the one in use stops working
during a shift, try the others. Never switch to a server whose CA fingerprint differs from the one
the terminal trusted at setup. Contains no patient, staff or financial data.
